title: Crabface's Sea Yarns

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You get me that rust remover yet, lubber?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You get me that rust remover yet, lubber?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: What, were you born with your head in a bucket? Half this city has metal skin. Try the Industrial Zone. Or the Sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What, were you born with your head in a bucket? Half this city has metal skin. Try the Industrial Zone. Or the Sewers.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You city folk. Always busy, flapping your feet and poking at your HUDs. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on a sturgeon’s scales?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You city folk. Always busy, flapping your feet and poking at your HUDs. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on a sturgeon’s scales?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: People troubles. It’s what happens on land.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People troubles. It’s what happens on land.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Aye. As far as the Oil Rig and the Islands. As far as the CorpSec buoys.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aye. As far as the Oil Rig and the Islands. As far as the CorpSec buoys.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: … Nothing out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: … Nothing out there.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Some folk say there ain’t. That past the buoys it's an endless ocean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some folk say there ain’t. That past the buoys it's an endless ocean.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: The other city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The other city.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Who knows? But the journey... that would be real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who knows? But the journey... that would be real.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: What would a lubber know about it? Go on, scram. And don’t come back ‘til you got some salt on your skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would a lubber know about it? Go on, scram. And don’t come back ‘til you got some salt on your skin.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Pah. Fool’s yarns and sea foam, that’s all. Your old boss used to talk about seeing it one day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pah. Fool’s yarns and sea foam, that’s all. Your old boss used to talk about seeing it one day.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Metal leggy thing in the sea. Used to drill for oil.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Metal leggy thing in the sea. Used to drill for oil.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Land bits in the sea. Covered in palm trees and CEOs. All the sand you can eat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Land bits in the sea. Covered in palm trees and CEOs. All the sand you can eat.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: With magic flying shoes. By boat, what the hell do you think? You’ll find your way there soon enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With magic flying shoes. By boat, what the hell do you think? You’ll find your way there soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Thaddeus could spin a yarn better than any mariner on these docks. He could make you believe anything’s possible. All talk, if you ask me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus could spin a yarn better than any mariner on these docks. He could make you believe anything’s possible. All talk, if you ask me.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Of course I’m right. None of us going nowhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I’m right. None of us going nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Some say if you keep sailing long enough, you’ll meet yourself coming back the other way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some say if you keep sailing long enough, you’ll meet yourself coming back the other way.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Others say if you drift for 500 days and 500 nights the winds will take you to Sang-Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Others say if you drift for 500 days and 500 nights the winds will take you to Sang-Ha.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Science. Pah! When did science ever help in a stage 5 typhoon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Science. Pah! When did science ever help in a stage 5 typhoon?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: How's the sailing going, lubber?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's the sailing going, lubber?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You haven't left this bay yet, have you? Shoulda known better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You haven't left this bay yet, have you? Shoulda known better.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: You city folk. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on the waves?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You city folk. When was the last time you sat and watched the way rainbows shimmer on the waves?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Aww. Good for you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aww. Good for you!

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Urban fishing galore. Sewer fish is good for one thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Urban fishing galore. Sewer fish is good for one thing.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: What do you think? Testing your radiation resistance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think? Testing your radiation resistance.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not sure where to look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not sure where to look.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m not sure where to look.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m not sure where to look.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry. Been a bit busy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry. Been a bit busy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess I’ve been distracted. With the LUZ and the killer and everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I’ve been distracted. With the LUZ and the killer and everything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess I’ve been distracted. With the LUZ and the killer and everything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess I’ve been distracted. With the LUZ and the killer and everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever been to sea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever been to sea?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever been to sea?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever been to sea?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about beyond?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about beyond?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There must be something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There must be something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sang Ha?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sang Ha?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think it's real?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think it's real?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. A real good way to die.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. A real good way to die.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah. A real good way to die.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah. A real good way to die.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds as if you’d like to see for yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds as if you’d like to see for yourself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds as if you’d like to see for yourself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds as if you’d like to see for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think that’s where he went?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think that’s where he went?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you think that’s where he went?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you think that’s where he went?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Islands?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Islands?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do I get there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do I get there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re probably right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re probably right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We might, one day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We might, one day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Or maybe he found a way out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or maybe he found a way out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Or maybe he found a way out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Or maybe he found a way out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds inviting. How do I get there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds inviting. How do I get there?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds inviting. How do I get there?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds inviting. How do I get there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's hard to come by!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hard to come by!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Now that you mention it: it's been a while?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now that you mention it: it's been a while?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Now that you mention it: it's been a while?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Now that you mention it: it's been a while?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does science say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does science say?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think that's true.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any other theories?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any other theories?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Didn't you say there's nothing out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't you say there's nothing out there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Didn't you say there's nothing out there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Didn't you say there's nothing out there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's not my boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's not my boss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not too bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not too bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Basically.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Basically.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've been to the Stacks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been to the Stacks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, I've been to the islands already.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I've been to the islands already.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hey, I've been to the islands already.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hey, I've been to the islands already.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've been to the Sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been to the Sewers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that?

nodes.text: Crabface's Sea Yarns
